display.purpose: The name in the info pane only (.info__name).

readout.purpose: Timecode, durations, counts, years, coordinates, offsets only. Never labels or names.

shadows.name: flat-underline-active-tab

shadows.name: flat-ring-current-clip

shadows.name: flat-underline-chat-focus
shadows.purpose: Chat form focus-within state, zero blur — not a shadow under the No Shadow Rule.

motion.name: playhead-linear
motion.purpose: The only authored motion: sequence playhead and page timeline bar playhead. Chrome never eases.

components.name: Pane / Bin head strip

components.name: Sequence Clip (video)
components.description: Signature component: a V1 clip on the sequence, teal fill, current-clip mango ring, 12% hover brighten.
components.css: .ds-clip{ display:grid; height:120px; padding:8px; background:#2c6b67; color:#dff5f2; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35); border-radius:2px; transition:filter .15s; text-decoration:none; } .ds-clip:hover{ filter:brightness(1.12); } .ds-clip--current{ box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #f4a23b; } .ds-clip-name{ font-family:'Barlow',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-clip-name small{ font-family:'Martian Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; opacity:.85; }

components.name: Sequence Clip (offline)
components.description: The offline-hatch clip-state code, chrome only, never over footage. Sanctioned in .impeccable/config.json detector ignore.
components.css: .ds-clip--offline{ display:grid; place-items:center; height:120px; padding:8px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #7a2e2e 0 8px, #5e2323 8px 16px); color:#fbdcdc; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35); border-radius:2px; font-family:'Barlow',sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-clip--offline small{ font-family:'Martian Mono',monospace; font-weight:400; }

narrative.overview:
The whole site is an edit in progress. The visitor lands inside Jeremy's suite: a program monitor playing the work, a sequence beneath it with every project as a clip sized by its real running time, bins for the rest of the site, and an info panel that says who he is. Nothing is decorated; every surface is a panel doing a job, and the work is the only colour on the page.

Chosen 2026-09-14 (direction round, seed f102dfc2) over Mezzotint Velvet Night and the incumbent Cutting Room system, now anti-reference. Built on branch facelift (5dc5139) against the approved prototype at .impeccable/mocks/proto/seq.html.

Motion grammar: one authored motion, the playhead (sequence and page timeline bar). It advances as the monitor previews each clip; drag to scrub; chrome never eases. Scroll-in reveals are retired: the playhead is the only authored motion left in the shipped build.
keyCharacteristics: Every region is a named panel: a 32px pane-head/bin-head strip, panels separated by hairlines, never shadows or space alone
One accent (mango) for the playhead, the active tab, the one primary action, the wordmark period, and two playhead-state indicators (transport timecode, current-clip ring)
Durations, timecodes and counts are true values from the data, set in the readout face; the running time lives in the transport timecode, not burned into the frame
Titles, clients and years are visible at rest on every clip and bin item
Square corners (clips 2px), flat surfaces, dense but legible chrome with an 11px floor on functional text
The offline-media hatch is a clip-state code on chrome only; it never touches footage

rules.name: The One Warm Rule
rules.body: Mango marks the playhead (sequence and page timeline bar), the active tab, the one primary action, the wordmark period, and the two playhead-state indicators (transport timecode, current-clip ring). If a second, unlisted mango element appears in a viewport, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Media Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal means video, green means audio, red hatch means offline. Colour on a clip states what it is, never how important it is. The hatch is chrome only.

rules.name: The Eleven Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 11px, in any panel, at any viewport.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where a value is measured (time, count, format, year, coordinate). Labels and names are never set in it.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A zero-blur inset box-shadow used as a flat underline or ring (active tab, current clip, chat form focus) is not a shadow under this rule.

dos: Do keep every timecode, duration and count true to the data; a readout that lies breaks the world.
Do show title, client and year at rest on every clip and every bin item.
Do keep footage untouched; the monitor and thumbnails show frames as shot, with the running time carried by the transport timecode, never burned into the frame.
Do keep the whole first-viewport suite inside one screen at desktop widths (1440x900 down to 1100).
Do honour reduced motion: no auto-advance, no auto-play, playhead at rest.
Do treat the offline hatch as chrome-only clip-state code, never as a texture on footage.
Do confine Caveat to the single Slide me! hint on the Thales comparison card; no other use is sanctioned.
donts: Don't add a second accent, a gradient, a glow, or a shadow with blur or offset.
Don't set any functional text below 11px or in monospace unless it is a measured value.
Don't reintroduce the incumbent pattern: eyebrow labels above headings, kickers, tiny section numbers, right-aligned meta stats, a spotlight behind the hero, pulsing dots.
Don't put a panel inside a panel; a bin opens as a full-width panel, never as a card grid of cards.
Don't burn a timecode into the program monitor frame; the direction contract names a burn-in but the footage-untouched constraint overrides it in the shipped build.
Don't extend Caveat, or invent a second script/display face, beyond the one sanctioned hint use.
